results.headline: US strikes Iran for tenth consecutive night as tankers burn in Hormuz
results.reason: summary: says the toll of US troops killed 'in the war since its resumption rose to 17,' but cited source A574 explicitly states only 'at least three U.S. service members dead since the resumption of hostilities a week ago' — 17 is the toll for the entire five-month war (per A28), not the toll since the war's resumption. This misstates the time-window/scope of the 17 figure.

results.headline: Houthis declare naval blockade on Saudi Arabia, threatening Red Sea oil route
results.reason: Matches source articles: embargo announcement, Bab el-Mandeb closure, 70%+ diversion to Yanbu, 7.4 million bpd June transit figure, and 7% global supply reduction estimate are all supported by A36/A51.

results.headline: Zelensky faces street protests and calls to sack top general after firing defence minister
results.reason: why_it_matters: attributes the public accusation against General Oleksandr Syrskiy to 'Fedorov's ousted deputy,' but cited source A579 states it was Ukraine's outgoing defense minister (Fedorov himself) who 'blamed Oleksandr Syrskiy for hindering military reforms in a fiery, public challenge.' No cited source mentions a deputy making this accusation — this misattributes the action to a different, unsupported entity.

results.headline: Trump imposes 50% tariffs on most Canadian goods, citing discrimination
results.reason: Matches source articles: tariff scope, discrimination rationale, Carney's 'direct violation of USMCA' quote, Ford's dollar-for-dollar call, Section 338 legal basis and Supreme Court context, and 30-day effective window are all supported by A24/A48.

results.headline: Andy Burnham takes office as UK's seventh prime minister in a decade
results.reason: summary: says Burnham replaced Starmer 'after barely two years in office,' but no cited source states the length of Starmer's tenure — this specific duration is absent from all cited articles' summaries/full text.

results.headline: Hamas elects hardline negotiator Khalil al-Hayya as new leader
results.reason: Matches source articles: two rounds of voting defeating Meshaal, age 65, surviving the September 2025 Doha airstrike, hardline/pro-Iran characterization, and analyst comments on disarmament resistance are all supported by A60/A168.

results.headline: Lebanese army deploys to first 'pilot zone' as Aoun meets Trump in Washington
results.reason: Matches source articles: deployment to Zawtar al-Gharbiyeh as one of three pilot-zone villages (A473), Aoun as first Lebanese president invited to Washington since 2009 (A30), and Hezbollah's rejection of the deal plus Israeli scepticism about disarmament (A30) are all supported.

results.headline: Philippine sailor injured as China coast guard clashes at Second Thomas Shoal
results.reason: why_it_matters: claims the clash 'occurred hours before Wang Yi arrived in Manila,' but no cited source states this specific timing — sources describe the clash (Monday) and Wang Yi's Manila visit for ASEAN talks as roughly concurrent, without specifying an hours-based gap.

results.headline: Israel believes Iran moved nuclear centrifuges underground as Iran election looms
results.reason: headline: says 'as Iran election looms,' but the cited election (A432) is Israel's general election set for October 27, not an Iranian election. The story's own summary correctly identifies it as 'Israel set a general election,' so the headline contradicts its own summary and the cited source's entity.

results.headline: Trump says Netanyahu will not be arrested in US; New York mayor presses ICC question
results.reason: Matches source articles: Trump's exact quote, the 2024 ICC arrest warrant, Mamdani's campaign pledge and 'actively considering' stance, US/Israel non-membership in the ICC, and Netanyahu's traditional September UN visits are all supported by A34.

results.headline: EU fines AliExpress a record €550 million under Digital Services Act
results.reason: Matches source articles: €550 million/$629 million fine, 193 million EU users, appeal plans, October 20 remediation deadline, and comparison to Temu's €200 million May fine are all supported by A110/A44.

results.headline: Nicaragua's Ortega declares elections will never be held again
results.reason: Matches source articles: Sandinista Revolution anniversary speech, nearly 20-year rule, 2021 jailing of candidates, quotes, January 2025 term extension to November 2027, and the 46 political prisoners figure are all supported by A156.

results.headline: Congo Ebola toll reaches 930 dead as outbreak spreads faster than health workers can track
results.reason: why_it_matters: claims 'armed conflict has triggered at least 12 attacks on health facilities,' but cited source A242 states the 12 attacks were 'mostly fueled by skepticism and rumors,' not armed conflict — a fabricated causal link between two individually supported facts.

results.headline: India's 'Cockroach' youth movement marches on parliament; police use tear gas and batons
results.reason: Matches source articles: 2.28 million students forced to resit, tear gas and cane charges, head injuries and a suspected broken leg, parliament's monsoon session adjournments, and the Google Form origin story are all supported by A58/A64.

results.headline: Chinese warship fires live rounds inside Japan's claimed exclusive economic zone
results.reason: Matches source articles: 180km from Okinotori, first acknowledged live-fire incident in the EEZ, Russian frigate present, 'groundless' Chinese rebuttal, and Takaichi's Taiwan-response comments are all supported by A530/A396.

results.headline: China considers tighter export controls on AI models and chips, FT reports
results.reason: summary: adds specifics that 'the move would mirror US restrictions on advanced chip exports to China' and that 'Chinese AI companies have rapidly expanded global reach,' neither of which appears in the only cited source's available summary text (which merely repeats the headline).

results.headline: France records 2,025 excess deaths in June heatwave; parliament to vote on social media ban for under-15s
results.reason: Matches source articles: 2,025 excess deaths, 43.8°C peak, 65% above normal in Paris, 50% in Centre-Val de Loire, 60% data completeness caveat, committee-level approval, September 1 effective date, Australia comparison, and the 2003 heatwave's ~15,000 toll and alert-system response are all supported by A81/A427.
